what: Pooled nested fit: accuracy ~ f(N) against f(N) + g H*_lat over the film N-curve cells, the C-ArmLSpine naming and detection cells and the matched-N render arms

model.M0: acc = A_c - B_c N^-C (A_c, B_c per corpus; one shared exponent C)
model.M1: acc = A_c - B_c N^-C + g H*_lat (one shared g)
model.likelihood: Gaussian, one variance, each point weighted by 1 / SE (SE = interval width / 3.92, floor 1.5 points); AICc = n ln(WRSS/n) + 2k + 2k(k+1)/(n-k-1) with k counting the variance
model.lr_test: n ln(WRSS0 / WRSS1) ~ chi-square(1) (estimated variance); the known-variance form WRSS0 - WRSS1 is reported beside it
model.N_units: per corpus (film persons, C-ArmLSpine cases, C-ArmLSpine frames added, render frames at matched N); absorbed by A_c and B_c

ipl.fitted_on: seed-mean accuracy at each N > 0, Figueroa rank weights
